title: fusion.review-response/v1
description: DRAFT, plan step 12: the reviewer's domain result, the profile's result_schema and the object the host places in the review request as output_contract. The shape is Prior's embedded modules/fusion/schemas/review-response.json at 167c605, adopted as plan step 12 says: its seven keys with their constraints unchanged, the decision enum accept, revise, escalate, which is also the verdict vocabulary of the role's own text (agents/reviewer.md). The step-1 analysis (261010-1504-span-map-and-repair-correspondence.md, Implications) names no reason against the shape: its five contradictions concern where the review sits and whether a rejection loops, which workflows/repair.v1.json settles with its review step and revise bound, not what the response carries. Two keys are added, both named by the role's Prior overlay (catalog/profiles/reviewer/parts/05-prior.md and 13-prior.md): domain, the domain the pass covered, echoed from the request; and findings, one entry per defect or question with its location, evidence and, for a defect, the executor and the acceptance test, empty on a pass that found nothing and never fabricated. participant, plan_hash, input_revisions and policy_version are echoed from the request's binding block, not supplied by the reviewer; the host refuses a response whose echo differs, and the reviewer's identity is the host's principal in host_evidence, never this echo. material_objections carries the reasons for the verdict, non-empty on revise and escalate; evidence names what the verdict rests on. The review step of workflows/repair.v1.json routes on decision: accept integrates, revise returns to the implementer within revise_bound, escalate stops for the user. The $schema keyword of the embedded file is dropped and the $id is fusion's: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

domain.description: Echoed from the request: the domain the pass covered.

findings.description: What the pass found, one entry each: a defect for the named executor with its acceptance test, or a question to settle. Empty when the pass found nothing.

severity.description: The role's own scale: Critical (release blocker, security, data loss), High (correctness bug, broken flow, structural ontology defect), Medium (correctness risk, maintainability), Low (cosmetic, style, cleanup).

location.description: file:line, or an entity id, verb name or manifest line for an ontology finding; every occurrence when the same problem appears elsewhere.

evidence.description: The exact code or entry, quoted, not paraphrased.

executor.description: On a defect: who fixes it, by the file's role and never its extension.

acceptance_test.description: On a defect: how the fix is verified.
